title: dispatch's brief names python3 _tools/backlog.py and the kb's tests.py rules, which a host project of the plugin does not have
goal: A worker brief that dispatch writes for a project whose backlog.py is the plugin's (its root holds no _tools/backlog.py) names every backlog.py command as python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}-resolved full path of the plugin's _tools/backlog.py, and names the kb-only rules (tests.py and its host lock, _tools/tests_ceiling.json, rag.py packs) only when the project has them, saying the project's own checks run instead; the kb's own briefs are unchanged

run: import sys; t=open('_tools/bl_dispatch.py').read(); sys.exit(1 if 'python3 _tools/backlog.py gate add' in t else 0)

repro_reason: the brief's fixed rules are string constants; running dispatch for a host project needs a second project with the plugin installed, which ST-tyzcqzfo builds
notes: Found by the worker of TK-p7ajxp72, which made only the role file line plugin-aware (bl_dispatch.role_file_line). The suite stands at 99 of 100 test ids after TK-p7ajxp72: no new test; prove the fix by the repro and a dispatch --dry-run brief read for a host project in ST-tyzcqzfo.
